coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three prompting methods and all three tasks. The required constants and precise dependent-variable definition are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Does not specify the NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, fixed random seeds, or the same framework installations and BoT repository configuration. Specifies 5 repeats instead of 10. Its primary outcome is raw wall-clock seconds; a logarithmic plotting axis does not explicitly establish the required base-10 logarithmic inference-time measure.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected inference-time conclusion nor the task-specific logarithmic values. The expected-direction discussion in design_output does not replace the missing conclusion and also overlooks that BoT is faster than PAL on Game of 24 in the reference table.
